derivation:
unfold dirichletD; refine continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => ?_
by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < d
· simpa [hi] using ((hg.fderiv_right (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiff_const).continuous.pow 2
· simp [hi]
explanation: `ContDiff.fderiv_right` gives smoothness of the bundled derivative from `hg`. Applying it to the constant basis vector gives smoothness, hence continuity, of each derivative term; squaring and taking the finite sum are routine closure steps. The existing proof already uses `hg.fderiv_right`.
